items.title: Theodore Purnell Interview, 1961-02-03
items.q: Judge always did play with me, you know, the job and he wasn't doing nothing. Well, that was my side drummer, you know?

ctx.x: Boy. Boy. Boy. You know nothing to do with Drunko, Harry Jones, don't leave your mouth. Judge. Yeah, Judge Ron. Oh yeah, man. Boy, Judge Ron come and sit in the band and shook the house, boy.
